文件托管于 GitHub Releases，部分网络环境下访问较慢。检查下载是否.zh: 文件托管于 GitHub Releases，部分网络环境下访问较慢。检查下载是否完整、设备空间与安装权限。若已安装旧的电脑连接型 APK，先导出进度；遇到签名不兼容时，不要直接卸载丢失存档。也可以先使用网页版本。
文件托管于 GitHub Releases，部分网络环境下访问较慢。检查下载是否.en: Files are hosted on GitHub Releases, which may be slow to access in certain network environments. Check whether the download is complete, as well as device space and installation permissions. If an older computer-connected APK is installed, export progress first; if there is a signature incompatibility, do not directly uninstall or lose your save. You can also use the web version first.

确认在同一桌面图标 / 浏览器中打开同一版本，而且完整离线资源已下载。Safar.en: Make sure to open the same version on the same desktop icon/browser, and that the full offline resources have been downloaded. Safari pages and home screen apps may use different storage; re-import the backup when switching entry points. Do not use incognito mode; if the device storage is insufficient, the system may reclaim website data. Export before cleaning.

游戏逻辑与存档在当前设备运行，网站只提供静态程序和资源；导入文件不发送到网站服务.en: The game logic and saves run on the current device; the website only provides static programs and resources. Imported files are not sent to the website server. The web version does not back up your data to the cloud, so please save the exported files to your own device or a cloud drive of your choice.

两版存档独立，可同时安装。离线版保留原客户端交互，无法从现有资料确定的服务端概率.en: The two editions have separate saves and can be installed side by side. The offline version retains the original client interactions; where server-side probabilities or timings cannot be established from the available materials, it uses local rules. Interactions with other players do not connect to real people. The Gallery Edition is for exploring collections; its resource rules cannot be carried over to the official servers.
